examined_formations.title: RETAIL_EDI_CHARGEBACK_RECOVERY_QUEUE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 零售 EDI 扣款争议恢复队列
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current brand hires an ongoing weekly specialist to review retailer deductions, assemble EDI/PO/ASN/invoice/BOL evidence, submit disputes and track dollars recovered. SPS Revenue Recovery already connects retailer/carrier data, validates deductions, retrieves proof documents, submits and re-submits disputes, tracks outcomes, and now auto-disputes eligible deductions across multiple retailers.

examined_formations.title: SAAS_REVENUE_STATE_DRIFT_REMEDIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: SaaS CRM/账单/产品授权状态漂移修复
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current company pays for a 6+ month role keeping Stripe, HubSpot and product entitlements aligned, fixing failed webhooks and provisioning drift. HubSpot Revenue Hub now manages quote-to-contract-to-billing lifecycle and natively syncs Stripe customers, invoices, subscriptions and payments; Workato connects HubSpot and Stripe, while dedicated entitlement systems handle runtime access. The residual third-system mapping remains customer-specific integration engineering rather than a repeatable independent exception unit.

examined_formations.title: SHIPMENT_EXCEPTION_RESOLUTION_QUEUE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 运输异常闭环处理队列
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current logistics operators are paid to resolve late deliveries, missed pickups, reroutes, damages and carrier exceptions. Modern post-purchase and visibility platforms already detect, classify and increasingly trigger exception-resolution workflows; the remaining hard actions require carrier, warehouse or customer coordination and therefore depend on external parties rather than a deterministic operator-owned action.

examined_formations.title: FREIGHT_INVOICE_DISCREPANCY_RECOVERY
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Freight invoice overcharges and discrepancies are crisp economic exceptions, but Cargobase already automates invoice matching, discrepancy detection, carrier notifications and a resolution centre tied to each invoice. New 2026 entrants also automate rate checking and dispute preparation, showing active product absorption rather than unowned remediation white space.

examined_formations.title: CROSS_SAAS_IDENTITY_ACCESS_EXCEPTION_REMEDIATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 跨 SaaS 身份与权限异常修复
examined_formations.evidence_summary: A current long-term IAM role pays for provisioning/revocation, failed-access review and cross-system access fixes. WorkOS Directory Sync abstracts SCIM provisioning/deprovisioning across directory providers, while the unresolved tail includes approvals, segregation-of-duties, least-privilege and incident judgment. Standard actions are control-plane features; nonstandard actions remain security-sensitive expert work.

examined_formations.title: TRAVEL_DISRUPTION_REISSUE_QUEUE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 旅行中断改签退票队列
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current travel buyers pay long-term specialists to service schedule changes, cancellations, refunds and reissues through Amadeus/Sabre. Acceptance is visible when the booking is re-serviced, but execution depends on airline fare rules, GDS commands, supplier policy and member communication; the buyer explicitly requires deep live-GDS expertise, so the core residual unit is not replaceable low-expertise remediation.
